EC1: 1. Currently enrolled in another research trial for investigative nutritional or other therapies thought to have an impact on immune system functioning.
EC2: 2. Unable to consent to the study.
EC3: 3. Women who are pregnant or are attempting conception, especially in the presence of a history of recurrent spontaneous abortion.
EC4: 4. Other medical complications [AND] that might [NOT] preclude one from participating in the study, i.e., recent heart attack [OR] or stroke [OR] or chronic kidney disease.
EC5: 5. Currently taking immunomodulatory medication, i.e. interferon.
EC6: 6. Currently taking other medications thought to have an impact on immune system functioning, i.e., chemotherapeutic agents.
EC7: 7. Known allergy [AND] to rice , rice bran, or related food products.
EC8: 8. Known allergy [AND] to mushrooms [OR] or related food products.
EC9: 9. History of malignancies [OR] related to the NK cell line, including: NK cell leukemias [OR] and T-cell large granular lymphocyte leukemias [OR], NK-cell lymphoproliferative disease of granular lymphocytes [OR], and NK cell lymphomas [OR], e.g., nasal [OR] and nasal-like NK/T-cell lymphomas.
